milestone.title: Code health: validation layer refactor + model split + output consistency

intent.outcome: Validation and verification logic has a single source of truth per gate; ac_verify has one execution path; mp-model is split into modules; duplicate gate invocations are removed; Human format behavior is explicit (removed or documented as alias). Contributors can find gate logic without reading an 800-line file.

problem.description: Review session identified organizational debt that does not block shipping but raises maintenance cost and drift risk. validate.rs is an 815-line monolith mixing full-plan scan, per-milestone gates (G1–G14), track/annotation rules, and command-time gate helpers (validate_milestone_ready, validate_milestone_start_execution) — G1/G4/G14 logic is duplicated between paths. ac_verify.rs has near-duplicate run_one/run_step_test and verify_milestone/verify_step_tests blocks (~170 lines of copy-paste). mp-model is a single 1032-line lib.rs god-file while TomlResource trait is declared but never implemented. Gate checks run twice on milestone execution start (commands/milestone.rs then milestone.rs inside with_milestone_mut). commands/common.rs emit() accepts a human parameter but ignores it — Fmt::Human and Fmt::Json both print pretty JSON, which contradicts M41 'mp is agent-only'. plan_gaps.rs and validate.rs overlap on coverage/readiness concepts with different report shapes.

in_scope: Split validate.rs into focused modules (e.g. validate/plan.rs, validate/milestone_gates.rs, validate/tracks.rs, validate/report.rs) with shared issue() helper — no behavior change, cargo test -p mp green
Extract shared gate functions used by both validate_plan and command-time paths (G1, G4, G8, G14) to eliminate duplication
Refactor ac_verify.rs: single run_test(value) -> Result path used by both AC verification and step-test guardrail
Remove duplicate validate_milestone_start_execution call chain (command handler OR domain, not both)
Split mp-model/src/lib.rs into modules (milestone.rs, plan.rs, track.rs, config.rs, normalize.rs) — re-export from lib.rs for stable paths
Remove or implement TomlResource trait (pick one: delete dead trait or wire store.rs through it)
Clarify Fmt::Human in mp: either remove Human variant from agent commands or document in cli.rs/AGENTS.md that Human is JSON alias (M41 agent-only — no raul-style tables)
Document plan_gaps vs validate responsibility boundary in ARCHITECTURE.md (when to call which)
out_of_scope: Behavior changes to gate thresholds (owned by M66)
cli.rs arg definition split (1049 lines — separate milestone if needed after validate split)
pub(crate) module boundary / lib.rs re-export reduction (future API hygiene)
raul human formatting (raul owns human output)

open_questions.question: Should validate/ submodules mirror gate codes (g4.rs) or layer (plan.rs, milestone.rs)?
open_questions.answer: Suggestion: layer-based (plan.rs, milestone.rs, tracks.rs, report.rs). Gate-per-file fragments too fast when one gate spans plan+milestone; layer matches how contributors reason about validate.

steps.done_when: No validate submodule over 400 lines; cargo test -p mp green
